intro: Trying to find Delaware scholarships that consider financial need and stay under the five-thousand-dollar range usually means sorting through smaller, more targeted programs rather than one-size-fits-all awards. This filtered USA view brings together a focused set of listings tied to Delaware, with examples spanning medicine, education, community, STEM, law, and other miscellaneous categories. You can apply more efficiently when you compare each row closely, because award amounts, deadlines, essay expectations, and eligibility details vary by program. Some listings appear to have lighter requirement signals, while others may ask for more supporting information. Since deadline text differs across these rows and at least some opportunities are coming up soon, it makes sense to check dates promptly and review eligibility signals and provider-path context on the provider application path before you apply.
